messages:
Mia M (marketing): Quick sync  We're aiming to publish the Optimizer 3.2 announcement on Thu 2026-03-12 10:00 PT. We need confirmed changelog URL, docs URL, final benchmark slugs, and assets by Wed 18:00 PT. Can eng confirm deploy plan & canary schedule?

Jon (eng): Plan set. Changelog PR #498 targets merge Wed 17:30 PT. Canary rollout Wed 19:00-20:30 PT in us-west-2. Will post canary start/end here.

Kai (docs): I'll freeze the docs build and stage the canonical URL once the PR merges. Draft is at /docs/optimizer/3.2-beta. Please don't share that one externally.

Mia M (marketing): Good. Marketing will hold on social/email until canary green. What are the pass/fail criteria for canary?

Jon (eng): Criteria: p95 < 300ms and error rate < 0.1% for 30m window. If p95 in 300-450ms we pause and triage; if error rate > 0.1% we rollback. Canary automation runs health checks and compares against baseline.

Nate (product): Add a secondary check: qualitative regression on 25 golden prompts (responsiveness/formatting). We'll run the suite during canary and report failures.

Jon (eng): Agreed. Please provide the golden prompt list as a gist by Wed 16:00 PT.

Mia M (marketing): Lina, can you prepare hero & 3 bench slides by Wed 15:00? Need PNG + SVG. Also export a CSV of benchmark numbers for the blog.

Lina (design): On it. I'll drop files to /drive/marketing/releases/opt3.2-assets by Wed 15:00.

Sasha (sales): For inbound, we'll set utm_campaign=opt3.2-launch and the lead tag release_optimizer_3_2. Route to SDR pool B. Confirmed.

Kai (docs): Reminder: canonical doc link will be https://docs.redwood.com/optimizer/3.2 once live. I'll paste final anchor after merge.

Jon (eng): Merging now. deploy-bot: Merge completed 2026-03-11T00:05Z. Starting canary at 2026-03-11T03:00Z PT.

deploy-bot: Canary progress logs: 5% -> 25% -> 50% traffic, running health checks. Intermediate metrics will be posted.

Jon (eng): Canary snapshot at +20m: p50=40ms, p95=265ms, errors=0.04%. Golden prompt run: 25/25 passed. Looks good so far.

Mia M (marketing): Copy. If green at 30m we'll plan to flip and marketing will send blog + social immediately. Please post final perf numbers and confirm cutover time.

Jon (eng): Canary end: 2026-03-11T04:05Z PT. Final metrics: p50=42ms, p95=272ms, p99=390ms, errors=0.03%. All golden prompts passed. Rolling to 100% now. deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed 2026-03-11T04:15Z PT.

deploy-bot: Canary and rollout successful (automated).

Mia M (marketing): :tada: Great news. Posting blog now. Blog URL: https://redwood.com/blog/optimizer-3-2-launch (live). Social drafts in /drive/marketing/releases/opt3.2-social.

Kai (docs): Docs live at https://docs.redwood.com/optimizer/3.2. Changelog link: https://docs.redwood.com/optimizer/3.2#changelog.

Sasha (sales): SDR routing live; leads tagged release_optimizer_3_2 and have utm campaign data.

Lina (design): Assets uploaded and linked in the post.

Nate (product): Webinar scheduled Thu 13:00 PT, 30m demo + 15m Q&A. Invite sent.

Mia M (marketing): Follow-ups: 1) Please add any post-launch anomalies to #postmortems. 2) If any regressions in first 24h, we want an internal note and a rollback plan. React with :white_check_mark: when you've confirmed your tasks.

Jon (eng): :white_check_mark:

Kai (docs): :white_check_mark:

Lina (design): :white_check_mark:

Sasha (sales): :white_check_mark:

Mia M (marketing): Thanks team. Closing thread.
